canonical_title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
description: An Anthropic researcher demonstrated that an automated system could self‑improve on ten specific benchmarks measuring misaligned behaviors, achieving better performance on each benchmark without any degradation in overall performance.

canonical_title: Boot a Virtual iPhone via Apple's Virtualization.framework
description: A GitHub project (vphone-cli) shows that Apple’s Virtualization.framework can be used to start a virtual iPhone instance, effectively emulating iOS hardware on a Mac machine.

canonical_title: Just the rumour of a bug is enough to find an exploit these days
description: Anil Madhavapeddy reported that security issues in OCaml projects are seeing attempted exploits within minutes of patches being shared for discussion, with a specific instance where exploit attempts began about ten minutes after a patch was posted. This is much faster than the usual few days to weeks before exploitation.
The GLM-5.3 language model has been released as open-weight, making its parameters publicly available.

canonical_title: Spreading the load: How Salesforce met Multi-AZ HA with SageMaker Inference Components
description: Salesforce used Amazon SageMaker AI Inference Component placement, specifically the SchedulingConfig parameter, to distribute copies of their models across multiple Availability Zones. This satisfied their Multi-AZ high‑availability compliance requirements while keeping the cost efficiency of multi‑model co‑hosting.
